property_summary: Rule: any second valid 10-ether fallback call made at a strictly later timestamp than a first successful call must succeed (the stored pastBlockTime equals the actual timestamp of the last call); the mutant stores timestamp+1, so a call exactly 1 second later incorrectly reverts.
change_summary: Replace the assignment with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so the stored value is one more than the timestamp.
